description: Job roles gaining company adoption — which titles are spreading across the market. Analyst tier. Compares each canonical role's company count today against a daily rollup snapshot windowDays ago (default 21) and returns roles that cleared the growth thresholds, plus genuinely NEW titles the classifier just started seeing (how 'Forward Deployed Engineer' was first caught). Use for 'what roles are companies suddenly hiring for?' or 'is the AI-engineer title spreading?'. Defaults: windowDays 21, minCompanies 5, minDelta 2, growthMin 25%, limit 20. Not for skill-level signals — use the companion `find_emerging_skills` for those.

growthMin.description: Minimum growth percentage over the window (default 25).

minCompanies.description: Minimum companies that must currently post the role (default 5).

minDelta.description: Minimum ABSOLUTE company-count gain over the window (default 2). Filters small-base noise.

windowDays.description: Growth window in days (default 21). Company adoption today is compared against the newest daily snapshot at or before this many days ago. The daily rollup began 2026-07-03 (90-day retention) — if the history is younger than the window, growth is measured over the available span and the response says so.

name: find_emerging_roles

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Roles gaining company adoption plus genuinely new titles

detectionsGeneratedAt.description: Timestamp of the pipeline's new-title detection run

growing.description: Roles clearing the growth thresholds, fastest % growth first

newInWindow.description: Present (true) when the role was absent at baseline

pctChange.description: Company growth %; null = role absent at baseline (new in window)

newTitles.description: Genuinely new titles the classifier just started seeing

firstSeen.description: Date the classifier first saw the title

note.description: Present when history is shorter than the requested window or data is unavailable

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Find Emerging Roles
